_provenance: X API v2 400 with a JSON problem body the mapper does not special-case (an invalid-request the query pre-validator did not catch). Per taxonomy, `validation` is reserved for LOCAL pre-call checks, so an API-returned 400 degrades to `api` with platform detail (DRIFT-2), non-retryable. Source: docs.x.com/x-api/fundamentals/errors invalid-request. Captured 2026-07-23. Exercises: api class from an unmapped 4xx, non-retryable.
